study.title: Drone-Aided Detection of Weeds: Transfer Learning for Embedded Image Processing
study.short_title: Drone-Aided Hogweed Detection with Edge Inference
study.venue: IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing

segmentation.best_model: SynthFakeRGN (U-Net segmentation + fake-RGN synthesis network, transfer learning)

dataset.name: UAV RGB + multispectral (MAPIR Survey3 RGN) hogweed imagery, two neighboring fields
dataset.note: DJI drone with FC330 RGB camera (3000x4000); training field also carried MAPIR Survey3 (red 660/green 550/NIR 850 nm, 0.5 FPS); two missions, old and young hogweed crops as separate classes; >20,000 128x128 training crops, 83 evaluation crops; also orthophotos via OpenDroneMap.

mIoU.quote: the U-Net model (see Table II) trained on orthophoto data gives a score of 75.3% when evaluated on frame data
mIoU.ambiguity: Reference absolute multiclass mIoU 75.3% (U-Net SynthFakeRGN trained on orthophoto data, evaluated on frame data); headline contributions are relative gains (+1.1% mIoU on RGB frame stream, +1.4% on orthophoto vs RGB-only). Tables I/II full values not fully captured in extraction.

F1.ambiguity: ROC-AUC and mIoU used as metrics.

fps.quote: we measure the inference speed per 12-MPx frame (3000 x 4000 pixel) in FPS, as well as the power consumption of the hardware in watts (W)
fps.ambiguity: FPS per 12-MPx frame measured on Jetson Xavier NX (tile inference 100x100, batch 1) reported in Table III; exact values not captured in markdown extraction. Real-time on-board scanning demonstrated; no quality loss vs server.

power_w.quote: we measure the inference speed per 12-MPx frame (3000 x 4000 pixel) in FPS, as well as the power consumption of the hardware in watts (W)
power_w.ambiguity: Power consumption (W) on Jetson Xavier NX reported in Table III; exact values not captured in markdown extraction.

params_M.quote: for the segmentation network, we have used a U-Net backbone consisting of three blocks in both the encoder and decoder parts with 17.3M parameters in total
params_M.ambiguity: U-Net segmentation network 17.3M params (deployed edge regime); synthesis head 2.2M (SegNet regime 29.5M + 7.8M).

issues: Table I/II/III full numeric values not captured by markdown extraction; FPS and power (W) values unavailable.
Flight altitude and GSD not reported.
